result:
Root cause: `strip_reminders` in `anthrouter/request_text.py` promised to "trim outer whitespace" but didn't. Removing the `<system-reminder>` block left a leading `\n`, so `startswith(ACTIVITY_LABEL_PREFIX)` failed.

Fix: `strip_reminders` now returns `.strip()`. Every caller gets trimmed text, not only `is_activity_label_prompt`.

Your example input now returns `True`. I couldn't run the test suite because pytest isn't installed here, so I haven't checked whether other tests depend on the old untrimmed output.
